name: Rectus femoris
dailyLifeRole: Lifts your knee when you step up and straightens it when you kick.

name: Vastus lateralis
dailyLifeRole: Straightens your knee to stand up from a chair.

name: Vastus medialis
dailyLifeRole: Helps lock your knee straight when you stand or climb stairs.

review.notes: Common claim that it targets the final degrees of extension is debated; not recorded. Needs a paper if wanted.

name: Vastus intermedius
dailyLifeRole: Works with the other quads to straighten your knee when you stand.

review.notes: Deep under rectus femoris, so no body-map slug of its own.

name: Biceps femoris
dailyLifeRole: Bends your knee and helps swing your leg back as you walk or run.

review.notes: Short head crosses only the knee (from general anatomy, not in the OpenStax summary I read): not recorded as a separate fact.

name: Semitendinosus
dailyLifeRole: Bends your knee and extends your hip when you push off.

name: Semimembranosus
dailyLifeRole: Bends your knee and extends your hip when you push off.

name: Adductor longus
dailyLifeRole: Pulls your leg back toward the middle, such as when you cross your legs.

name: Adductor magnus
dailyLifeRole: Pulls your thigh inward and helps extend the hip when you stand or climb.

review.notes: Question: the split between its adductor part and hamstring part is not recorded here.

name: Gracilis
dailyLifeRole: Draws your thigh inward and helps bend your knee as you walk.

name: Gastrocnemius
dailyLifeRole: Pushes you up onto your toes when you walk, run or jump.

name: Soleus
dailyLifeRole: Keeps you steady on your feet when you stand and walk.

name: Tibialis anterior
dailyLifeRole: Lifts your toes so your foot clears the ground when you step.
